root_idea.summary: The root has a basic orientation toward time, especially the year and the passage of years.
root_idea.development: From the notion of a year or the passing of years, the evidence develops usages for aging and alteration, annual recurrence, yearly contracts, and a year characterized by drought.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form V perfect citation form تَسَنَّهَ.

senses.definition: To become altered for the worse through the passage of years; to lose freshness or become spoiled with age.
senses.usage_conditions: In the supplied Quranic occurrence, the verb is negated and is said of food and drink: they had not undergone alteration through the lapse of years.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make an engagement or contract for work by the year; to hire or employ someone on a yearly basis.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form III construction used with a person or work arrangement, with the yearly period expressed as the basis of the contract.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a palm-tree: to bear in one year and not in the next.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional description of alternate-year bearing.
In the cited usage, the final radical is changed to ت, giving forms such as أَسْنَتُوا.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To remain, stay, dwell, or abide with someone for a year.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with a person or that person’s abode, with the duration of a year understood.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To undergo the passage of years; to age over time.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said of a palm-tree and, more generally, of other things that have endured the lapse of years. This broader classical use is distinct from the Quranic use concerning alteration of food and drink.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A year; a period of time corresponding broadly to a full year.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used as a synonym of حَوْلٌ or عَامٌ. One reported distinction treats سَنَةٌ as longer than عَامٌ, while the evidence also records the two as synonyms. It may be applied tropically to a single season or quarter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Drought, barrenness, or a year of severe dearth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized use of the year-word for drought-afflicted conditions; it may be said of land or people affected by drought and of a year lacking rain or herbage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of food or drink: aged through the lapse of years and consequently stale, mouldy, musty, or spoiled.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied especially to bread, food, and beverages that have deteriorated with age.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a palm-tree: bearing in one year and not another, or being affected by a year of drought; of a year: lacking herbage or rain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The adjective is applied according to the noun described, especially a palm-tree or a drought-stricken year.

cautions: The supplied QAC inventory contains only the Form V verb occurrence; nominal Quran citations discussed in the lexical evidence are therefore retained as classical lexical entries rather than assigned to an additional QAC form.
The Mufradat discussion explicitly distinguishes سِنَةٌ in لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ [2:255] from this root, deriving that usage from الوسن; it is not included here as a sense of س ن ه.
